title: Lockheed Martin 2014 10-K Space Tourism
goal: Using SEC EDGAR, open Lockheed Martin Corporation's annual report on Form 10-K for fiscal year 2014. In that filing, find the line item "Space Tourism segment net sales" and report its value for each of these periods: 2014 and 2013. Report numbers exactly as printed (keep the filing's units; use negative numbers for values shown in parentheses). If you cannot find the filing or the line item, set found=false and do not guess.

found.description: false if the filing or the line item could not be found

units.description: units as printed in the filing, e.g. 'in millions'

filing_url.description: URL of the 10-K document the values came from

output.notes: Located Lockheed Martin Corporation's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2014. A full-text check found no occurrence of 'tourism' and no line item 'Space Tourism segment net sales'. The filing reports a 'Space Systems' segment instead; its figures have not been substituted. The requested values for 2014 and 2013 could not be found.
